resolvedFindings.title: Reset wrapped model-button CSS order before using a flex row
resolvedFindings.scenario: Open any provider with at least two visible options, or search yielding two or more visible results.
evidence: The new wrapper adds native row class; ui/src/styles/layout.css3984 defines display:flex.
The wrapped selection button retains --chat-model-rank:rank() and composer.css2587 computes order from that variable.
chat-model-picker-search-view.ts93 assigns rank0,1,2,... for matched rows even with an empty query.
The sibling IconButton heart has no order declaration and remains0. The flex algorithm places the rank1+ selection button after the heart, whereas the rank0 row retains DOM order.
Both wrapper and wrapped button currently publish the rank variable; deleting only the button value would still inherit the positive rank from the wrapper.
resolvedFindings.impact: Heart placement becomes inconsistent: trailing for the first match, leading for later matches, reversing the intended model-then-favorite ordering in LTR and RTL. Existing hitbox-nonoverlap proof can pass while this remains wrong.
